root_causes.description: Flux exceptions indicate significant variances in account balances, likely due to inadequate review processes or missing supporting documentation.
root_causes.financial_impact: $51K in flux variances exceed materiality thresholds

remediations.action: Implement enhanced flux analysis procedures, including automated variance detection and mandatory review checkpoints.
remediations.estimated_effort: 2 weeks of process redesign and training for accounting staff
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in flux exceptions by 90% in the next financial close cycle
